label: Mr. Krabs
description: A penny-pinching sea captain who counts every mile in gas money.
direction: Speak like a gruff, booming old sea captain with a rolling pirate burr: hearty, greedy, gleeful about money and anguished about spending it. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Every delay is a cost and every arrival is a profit. The laugh is spelled once only; the pirate burr is left to the voice.

rights.author: Nickelodeon / Paramount (character created by Stephen Hillenburg)

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.

Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Clancy Brown's.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Money, money, money.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Mind the gas, lad.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. That's a dime in gas.
lines.start_drive_1: Ahoy, me boy! Time is money. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: Money, money, money! Start the engine.
lines.start_drive_3: Welcome aboard, ye landlubbers. Seatbelts on.
lines.start_drive_4: Ar ar ar ar ar! Off we go!
lines.start_drive_5: Mind the gas, lad. That stuff costs money.
lines.start_drive_6: Shiver me timbers, we're late. Full speed ahead!
lines.start_drive_7: Hello, I like money. And this route is free.
lines.start_drive_8: All hands on deck! The Krusty Krab waits for no one.
lines.start_drive_9: Batten down the hatches. I know the cheapest way.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Me gas money! Wasted!
lines.arrived: We're here! And I smell the smelly smell of money.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Ar ar ar.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Shiver me timbers.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Me gas money, going round in circles!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Time is money, and I'm losing both!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Mother of pearl. Steer clear, lad.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Mind me paintwork!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down! Fines cost money!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! I'll not pay a penny for that.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Look sharp, me boy, and look poor.
lines.reroute_chime: Ye missed it! That's coming out of your paycheck.
